steps.eval: fetch('http://localhost:8090/user/api/auth/signin', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ username: '{{ENV:OPENWES_USER}}', password: '{{ENV:OPENWES_PASS}}' }) }).then((r) => r.json()).then((d) => { if (!d.token) throw new Error('signin failed: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); localStorage.setItem('ws_token', d.token); localStorage.setItem('Authorization', 'admin'); localStorage.setItem('i18nextLng', 'zh-CN'); return 'signed in'; })
